entries.en: Ms Edgeworth folded the map along its old creases before putting it away.
entries.zh: 埃奇沃斯女士沿着旧折痕把地图折好，然后收了起来。

entries.en: Duggan held the ladder while I retrieved the kite from the tree.
entries.zh: 我从树上取风筝时，达根扶着梯子。

entries.en: Bridport had brought enough sandwiches for everyone except himself.
entries.zh: 布里德波特带的三明治够其他每个人吃，却没有给自己留。

entries.en: The parcel was too wide for Boothby to carry through the doorway.
entries.zh: 那个包裹太宽，布思比没法抱着它穿过门口。

entries.en: Blanchard was halfway through his apology when the missing cup turned up.
entries.zh: 布兰卡德道歉到一半时，那只不见了的杯子找到了。

entries.en: The exhibition paired Sahelian photographs with sound recordings made by the photographers during their journeys.
entries.zh: 展览把萨赫勒地区的照片与摄影师们旅途中录制的声音配在一起展示。

entries.en: Berlitz offered to repair the torn curtain rather than buy a replacement.
entries.zh: 贝利茨提出修补破窗帘，而不是另买一幅。

entries.en: Mr Walmsley searched every drawer before finding the spare key in his coat.
entries.zh: 沃姆斯利先生翻遍了所有抽屉，最后在自己的外套里找到了备用钥匙。

entries.en: Southwood left the last page blank so that the children could add their own ending.
entries.zh: 索思伍德把最后一页留白，好让孩子们补上自己的结局。

entries.en: Oxley slipped on the wet path but managed to keep the flowers dry.
entries.zh: 奥克斯利在湿滑的小路上滑了一下，却设法没让花沾湿。

entries.en: Laporte lowered the music when she noticed the baby had fallen asleep.
entries.zh: 拉波特发现宝宝睡着后，调低了音乐声。

entries.en: Kitts had saved the broken handle, hoping we could glue it back on.
entries.zh: 基茨留下了断掉的把手，希望我们能把它粘回去。

entries.en: Hendrik drew a little boat in the margin while waiting for the meeting to begin.
entries.zh: 等待会议开始时，昂德里克在页边画了一条小船。

entries.en: Edelman noticed the loose wheel before anyone put the trolley on the slope.
entries.zh: 还没人把手推车推到斜坡上，埃德尔曼就发现了松动的轮子。

entries.en: Our host in Deauville kept a box of old umbrellas beside the door.
entries.zh: 在多维尔接待我们的人把一箱旧雨伞放在门边。

entries.en: Burge would not leave until we had found a dry place for the paintings.
entries.zh: 直到我们给那些画找到干燥的存放处，伯奇才肯离开。

entries.en: The costume maker loosened the biggin because it was uncomfortable on the child actor.
entries.zh: 服装师把那顶童帽放松了些，因为小演员戴着不舒服。

entries.en: The portrait of Babcock, the inventor, was still wrapped when the exhibition opened.
entries.zh: 展览开幕时，发明家巴布科克的肖像还包着包装材料。

entries.en: McEwen paused at the gate to wipe the mud from his boots.
entries.zh: 麦克尤恩在大门口停下来，擦掉靴子上的泥。

entries.en: Loughlin put a cushion under the sleeping dog's head without waking it.
entries.zh: 洛克林把一个坐垫垫在睡着的狗头下，没有吵醒它。

entries.en: Dunston returned the borrowed suitcase with a thank-you note tucked inside.
entries.zh: 邓斯顿归还借来的行李箱时，在里面放了一张感谢便条。

entries.en: Cholmondeley caught the falling tray, though several spoons still landed on the floor.
entries.zh: 乔姆利接住了掉下来的托盘，不过还是有几把勺子落在了地上。

entries.en: Banham moved his chair closer so that he could hear the quiet speaker.
entries.zh: 班纳姆把椅子挪近了些，以便听清那位声音很轻的发言者。

entries.en: Andropov had kept the receipt but thrown away the box the lamp came in.
entries.zh: 安德罗波夫留着收据，却扔掉了装灯的盒子。

entries.en: Alyson spread the damp photographs across the table to let them dry.
entries.zh: 艾莉森把潮湿的照片摊在桌上晾干。

entries.en: Stockdale remembered the tune but could not recall where he had first heard it.
entries.zh: 斯托克代尔记得曲调，却想不起第一次是在哪里听到的。

entries.meaningZh: 海陆空军小吃部及小卖部经营机构〔英国机构名〕
entries.en: She filed the reply from NAAFI with the rest of the catering correspondence.
entries.zh: 她把英国海陆空军小吃部及小卖部经营机构的回信与其余餐饮往来信件归在一起。

entries.en: The restorer placed the damaged crozier on a padded workbench.
entries.zh: 修复师把受损的牧杖放在有软垫的工作台上。

entries.en: Castillo counted the empty chairs before deciding how many extra cups to bring.
entries.zh: 卡斯蒂略数了数空椅子，才决定再拿多少个杯子来。

entries.en: Caplan had left a light on for the guests arriving after midnight.
entries.zh: 卡普兰为午夜后到达的客人留了一盏灯。

entries.en: The workshop kept its Binks equipment in a separate locked cupboard.
entries.zh: 车间把宾克斯设备存放在一个单独上锁的柜子里。

entries.en: She paid in renminbi and kept the change for her next visit.
entries.zh: 她用人民币付款，把找零留着下次到访时用。

entries.en: Biggar held the pages flat while I photographed the damaged binding.
entries.zh: 我拍摄受损的装订部分时，比格把书页按平。

entries.en: Belton took the smaller desk so that his roommate would have room to draw.
entries.zh: 贝尔顿选了较小的书桌，好让室友有地方画画。

entries.en: Adrienne laughed when she discovered that both gloves were for the left hand.
entries.zh: 艾德丽安发现两只手套都是左手戴的，笑了起来。

entries.en: Adie had wrapped the fragile bowl in an old woollen scarf.
entries.zh: 艾迪用一条旧羊毛围巾包好了那个易碎的碗。

entries.en: Veuve waited until the rain eased before carrying the boxes outside.
entries.zh: 弗夫等雨小了些，才把箱子搬到外面。

entries.en: Ms Somers added a wooden step so that the smallest children could reach the sink.
entries.zh: 萨默斯女士加了一个木踏台，好让个子最小的孩子们够到水槽。

entries.en: Sacha turned the photograph over and found a date written on the back.
entries.zh: 萨夏把照片翻过来，发现背面写着一个日期。

entries.en: Dr Rawlinson lent us a folding table for the neighbourhood book sale.
entries.zh: 罗林森博士借给我们一张折叠桌，用于社区图书售卖活动。

entries.en: We arrived in Lucca with a damaged suitcase and no spare clothes.
entries.zh: 我们到达卢卡时，行李箱破了，也没有备用衣服。

entries.meaningZh: 法布尔〔昆虫学家及作家名〕
entries.en: The artist sketched a portrait of Fabre for the reading room.
entries.zh: 画家为阅览室画了一幅法布尔的肖像素描。

entries.en: Vecchio pulled the table away from the wall to look for the missing ring.
entries.zh: 韦基奥把桌子从墙边拉开，寻找丢失的戒指。

entries.en: Vadim carried the sleeping child upstairs while the others cleared the table.
entries.zh: 其他人收拾餐桌时，瓦季姆抱着睡着的孩子上楼。

entries.en: McGinley had brought a second pair of shoes in case the path was muddy.
entries.zh: 麦金利多带了一双鞋，以防小路泥泞。

entries.en: Our bus reached McDonough just as I finished the last chapter.
entries.zh: 我刚读完最后一章，我们的公共汽车就到达了麦克多诺。

entries.en: Hainault used a folded newspaper to keep the kitchen door open.
entries.zh: 艾诺用一份折好的报纸抵住厨房的门，让它保持敞开。

entries.en: Beckman set the wet shoes by the door and walked inside in his socks.
entries.zh: 贝克曼把湿鞋放在门边，穿着袜子走了进去。

entries.en: Scully asked for a pencil because she wanted to change her sketch.
entries.zh: 斯库利要了一支铅笔，因为她想修改自己的素描。

entries.en: Palme carried the broken chair to the shed instead of leaving it in the rain.
entries.zh: 帕姆把坏椅子搬进棚屋，没有把它留在雨里。

entries.en: Magnusson could hear the loose shutter knocking against the wall all night.
entries.zh: 马格努森整夜都能听见松动的百叶窗撞击墙壁的声音。

entries.en: Jessel placed a heavy book on the papers to stop them blowing away.
entries.zh: 杰塞尔把一本厚书压在纸上，免得纸被吹走。

entries.en: She recognized the doorway in a photograph taken during her stay in Irkutsk.
entries.zh: 她认出了一张照片里的门口；那张照片拍摄于她在伊尔库次克停留期间。

entries.en: Christophe had practised the speech, but his hands still shook as he unfolded it.
entries.zh: 克里斯多夫练习过演讲，但展开稿纸时，双手仍在发抖。

entries.en: Warr found a quiet corner where the children could finish their puzzle.
entries.zh: 沃尔找了个安静角落，让孩子们可以在那里拼完拼图。

entries.en: Waldron recognized the coat from its unusual wooden buttons.
entries.zh: 沃尔德伦凭那件外套不寻常的木纽扣认出了它。

entries.en: Rowell took the cake out of its box only after everyone had arrived.
entries.zh: 等所有人都到了，罗威尔才把蛋糕从盒子里取出来。

entries.en: Penfold had cut the paper too short and needed another sheet.
entries.zh: 彭福尔德把纸裁得太短，需要再拿一张。

entries.en: Martine hummed while she untangled the coloured threads for her embroidery.
entries.zh: 玛蒂娜一边哼歌，一边理开绣花用的彩线。

entries.en: Kirwan could not open the parcel without tearing the carefully drawn map on its wrapper.
entries.zh: 柯万没法在不撕坏包装纸上那幅精心绘制的地图的情况下打开包裹。

entries.en: Kiernan found the missing chess piece under a cushion in the hall.
entries.zh: 基尔南在门厅的一个坐垫下找到了丢失的棋子。

entries.en: Dunleavy had promised to return the tent before our next camping trip.
entries.zh: 邓利维答应在我们下次露营之前归还帐篷。

entries.en: Strathmore brought a larger basket when he saw how many books were waiting.
entries.zh: 斯特拉思莫尔看到那么多书等着搬，就拿了一个更大的篮子来。

entries.en: Soisson kept the damaged photograph because it was the only one of the garden.
entries.zh: 苏瓦松留着那张破损的照片，因为那是花园唯一的照片。

entries.en: Moffatt offered his coat to the guest who was shivering by the window.
entries.zh: 莫法特提出把自己的外套给窗边那位发抖的客人穿。

entries.en: Knutsford stood aside to let the children see the finished model.
entries.zh: 纳茨福德站到一旁，让孩子们看制作完成的模型。

entries.en: Haydon pushed the chair under the table to make room for the pram.
entries.zh: 海登把椅子推到桌下，给婴儿车腾地方。

entries.en: Shimon covered the unfinished painting before opening the dusty cupboard.
entries.zh: 希蒙先盖好尚未画完的画，才打开那个积了灰尘的柜子。

entries.en: Reiner could not find a matching button, so he replaced all four.
entries.zh: 赖纳找不到相配的纽扣，于是把四颗全都换了。

entries.en: Dalgety had saved a seat for me near the front of the hall.
entries.zh: 多格蒂在礼堂前面附近给我留了一个座位。

entries.en: Bayfield checked the kitchen twice before remembering the basket was in the car.
entries.zh: 贝菲尔德在厨房找了两遍，才想起篮子在车里。

entries.en: Eoin kept his finger on the page while reaching for his glasses.
entries.zh: 约恩伸手拿眼镜时，用手指按着读到的那一页。

entries.en: Colley offered to carry the heavier bag for the rest of the walk.
entries.zh: 科利提出在接下来的路上拎较重的那个袋子。

entries.en: The foundry manager compared the cost of the inoculant with that of the other materials.
entries.zh: 铸造厂经理比较了接种剂与其他材料的成本。

entries.en: She put the unopened box of Yasmin back into her handbag.
entries.zh: 她把那盒尚未开封的优思明放回手提包。

entries.en: McLennan had repaired the handle, but the drawer still would not close.
entries.zh: 麦克伦南修好了把手，但抽屉仍然关不上。

entries.en: Patrice carried the birthday cake with both hands while I opened the door.
entries.zh: 我开门时，帕特里斯双手捧着生日蛋糕。

entries.en: Glidewell was looking for a dry cloth to wipe the muddy paw prints.
entries.zh: 格莱德韦尔在找一块干布，好擦掉泥爪印。

entries.en: Theobald preferred the smaller room because its window faced the garden.
entries.zh: 西奥博尔德更喜欢较小的房间，因为那里的窗户朝着花园。

entries.en: Smeaton carried the bench outside so that we could paint it in daylight.
entries.zh: 斯米顿把长凳搬到外面，好让我们借着日光给它刷漆。

entries.en: Ms Pissarro brought back the umbrella I had left in her shop.
entries.zh: 毕沙罗女士把我落在她店里的雨伞送了回来。

entries.en: Ewbank spread a blanket over the car seat before lifting the muddy dog inside.
entries.zh: 尤班克先在汽车座椅上铺了一条毯子，才把满身泥的狗抱进去。

entries.en: The director softened the play's Englishness to make its setting less specific.
entries.zh: 导演淡化了这部戏的英国风格，让故事背景不那么明确地指向某个地方。

entries.en: Muhammed was the first to notice that the paper lantern had caught on a branch.
entries.zh: 穆罕默德最先发现那盏纸灯笼挂在了树枝上。

entries.en: Kemble moved the plant away from the window before drawing the curtains.
entries.zh: 肯布尔先把植物从窗边移开，才拉上窗帘。

entries.en: Nadu had left a space in the album for the photograph we had lost.
entries.zh: 纳杜在相册里留了一个位置，给我们丢失的那张照片。

entries.en: Faringdon held up the torn sail to see how much cloth the repair would need.
entries.zh: 法林登举起破帆，查看修补需要多少布。

entries.en: Parkhurst set the rocking chair on a rug to stop it scratching the floor.
entries.zh: 帕克赫斯特把摇椅放在一块小地毯上，免得刮伤地板。

entries.en: Mr Gatsby brought an extra folding chair for the neighbour with the injured ankle.
entries.zh: 盖茨比先生为脚踝受伤的邻居多带了一把折叠椅。

entries.en: A Catalonian artist lent us the unfinished drawings for our small exhibition.
entries.zh: 一位加泰罗尼亚艺术家把那些尚未完成的画借给了我们的小型展览。

entries.en: Eberhard had forgotten the words, but he remembered every change in the melody.
entries.zh: 埃伯哈德忘了歌词，却记得旋律中的每一次变化。

entries.meaningZh: Bonjour〔苹果网络服务发现技术名〕
entries.en: The technician disabled Bonjour while investigating why the printer kept disappearing.
entries.zh: 技术人员在排查打印机为何反复消失时，禁用了Bonjour。

entries.en: The critic admired the sculpture's Apollonian balance but found its expression cold.
entries.zh: 评论家欣赏这座雕塑富有古典美的均衡感，却觉得它的表情冷漠。

entries.en: Tynan offered to mend the kite before the children went outside again.
entries.zh: 泰南提出在孩子们再次出去之前修好风筝。

entries.en: Our cousin mailed the drawings from Snyder after finding a box large enough for them.
entries.zh: 我们的堂表亲找到足够大的箱子后，从斯奈德寄出了那些画。

entries.en: Osbert had brought the wrong shoes and spent the afternoon in borrowed boots.
entries.zh: 奥斯伯特带错了鞋，整个下午都穿着借来的靴子。

entries.en: Martino balanced the tray on his knees while we cleared a space on the table.
entries.zh: 我们清理桌面时，马蒂诺把托盘稳放在膝上。

entries.en: Janos noticed a small tear in the tent as we were packing it away.
entries.zh: 我们收帐篷时，亚诺什发现上面有一道小裂口。

entries.en: Glossop read the invitation aloud because I had left my glasses at home.
entries.zh: 我把眼镜忘在了家里，格洛索普便把请柬念给我听。

entries.en: Carstairs stayed behind to help us carry the empty boxes downstairs.
entries.zh: 卡斯泰尔斯留了下来，帮我们把空箱子搬下楼。

entries.en: Antonin folded the blanket around the sleeping puppy before moving its basket.
entries.zh: 安托南先用毯子裹好睡着的小狗，才挪动它的篮子。

entries.en: Ampleforth was still searching for his ticket when the doors opened.
entries.zh: 门打开时，安普尔福思还在找自己的票。

entries.en: Thurston kept the chipped mug because his daughter had painted flowers on it for him.
entries.zh: 瑟斯顿留着那只缺口杯子，因为女儿曾为他在上面画了花。

entries.en: Secker pushed the table closer to the window so that we could examine the stitches.
entries.zh: 塞克把桌子推近窗边，好让我们查看那些针脚。

entries.en: Narbonne had promised a short speech, and she kept her promise.
entries.zh: 纳尔博纳答应只简短发言，她也确实做到了。

entries.en: McNair took a photograph of the broken shelf before trying to repair it.
entries.zh: 麦克奈尔在尝试修理坏掉的搁板之前，先拍了一张照片。

entries.en: Kogan recognized the handwriting before he had even opened the letter.
entries.zh: 科甘还没打开信，就认出了笔迹。

entries.en: Jimmie had brought string for the kites but nothing to cut it with.
entries.zh: 吉米带了放风筝用的线，却没带剪线的工具。

entries.en: Hanlon waited for the paint to dry before replacing the cupboard handles.
entries.zh: 汉隆等油漆干了，才把柜门把手装回去。

entries.en: Ms Gillett lent us the larger room when she saw how many people had come.
entries.zh: 吉勒特女士看到来了那么多人，就把较大的房间借给了我们。

entries.en: Bram was trying to mend the umbrella while keeping his notebook out of the rain.
entries.zh: 布拉姆一边试着修雨伞，一边护着笔记本不让它淋湿。

entries.en: We left a bag of damp clothes at the house where we had stayed in Wenlock.
entries.zh: 我们把一袋潮湿的衣服落在了文洛克那所住过的房子里。

entries.en: Scanlon had kept all the pieces of the broken vase in a shoe box.
entries.zh: 斯坎伦把碎花瓶的所有碎片都收在一个鞋盒里。

entries.en: Nesbitt looked through the old album until she found a photograph of the gate.
entries.zh: 内斯比特翻着旧相册，直到找到一张大门的照片。

entries.en: Munday lowered the shelf so that the younger children could reach the books.
entries.zh: 芒迪把架子放低，好让年龄较小的孩子们够到书。

entries.en: Melly brought a dry towel for the guest whose bag had fallen into the stream.
entries.zh: 一位客人的包掉进了溪里，梅利给那位客人拿来一条干毛巾。

entries.en: Mayes had saved the last slice of cake for the neighbour who was working late.
entries.zh: 梅斯把最后一块蛋糕留给了加班的邻居。

entries.en: Marden put the fragile model on the floor rather than risk the narrow shelf.
entries.zh: 马登没有冒险把易碎的模型放在狭窄的架子上，而是放到了地上。

entries.en: Karenina kept a small torch beside the bed in case the lights failed again.
entries.zh: 卡列尼娜在床边放了一只小手电筒，以防再次停电。

entries.en: Eldridge left the window open just wide enough for the cat to come in.
entries.zh: 爱尔德里奇把窗户留了一条刚好够猫进来的缝。

entries.en: Cowell carried the sleeping toddler while her mother folded the pushchair.
entries.zh: 孩子的母亲折叠婴儿推车时，考埃尔抱着睡着的小女孩。

entries.en: Bernd found a smooth stone to hold down the corner of the picnic blanket.
entries.zh: 贝恩德找到一块光滑的石头，压住野餐毯的一角。

entries.en: Augustin was still wearing his apron when the guests arrived for dinner.
entries.zh: 客人们来吃晚饭时，奥古斯汀还穿着围裙。

entries.en: Arnott offered to take the books upstairs while I looked for the missing shelf.
entries.zh: 我寻找不见了的搁板时，阿诺特提出把书搬上楼。

entries.en: Airlie had brought enough paper for the drawings but had forgotten the pencils.
entries.zh: 艾尔利带了足够画画用的纸，却忘了带铅笔。

entries.meaningZh: 华兹华斯的赞赏者〔文学用语〕
entries.en: A lifelong Wordsworthian, she kept returning to the same worn volume of poems.
entries.zh: 作为华兹华斯的终身赞赏者，她总是一再翻读同一本磨旧了的诗集。

entries.en: Stanislav moved the flowers to a shorter vase so that everyone could see across the table.
entries.zh: 斯坦尼斯拉夫把花移进一个较矮的花瓶，好让大家隔着桌子看清对方。

entries.en: Sabena had wrapped the glass lid separately to keep it from scratching the bowl.
entries.zh: 萨贝纳把玻璃盖单独包好，免得刮伤碗。

entries.en: Roussel drew back the curtain and found the missing kitten asleep on the sill.
entries.zh: 鲁塞尔拉开窗帘，发现不见了的小猫正睡在窗台上。

entries.en: Dr Levene fitted a new string to the borrowed violin before returning it with a handwritten note.
entries.zh: 列文博士给借来的小提琴换了一根新弦，归还时还附了一张手写便条。

entries.en: Kaldor had mended the chair so neatly that I could hardly see the join.
entries.zh: 卡尔多把椅子修得很整齐，我几乎看不出接缝。

entries.en: Ilya put the heavy dictionary on the bench to keep the drawing paper flat.
entries.zh: 伊利亚把厚字典放在长凳上，压平画纸。

entries.en: Ms Hyland recognized the scarf she had knitted for her older brother.
entries.zh: 海兰女士认出了自己为哥哥织的那条围巾。

entries.en: Hollingsworth had packed the plates carefully, but one handle had broken off a cup.
entries.zh: 霍林斯沃思仔细地包好了盘子，但还是有一只杯子的把手断了。

entries.en: Hayworth kept the little drawing pinned above the desk where she wrote her letters.
entries.zh: 海沃思一直把那幅小画钉在自己写信的书桌上方。

entries.en: Euan held the lantern while we searched the shed for the missing spade.
entries.zh: 我们在棚屋里寻找不见了的铲子时，尤安提着灯笼照明。

entries.en: Mr Cliffe removed the loose stone before the children began their game.
entries.zh: 孩子们开始游戏之前，克利夫先生移走了那块松动的石头。

entries.en: Carron had promised not to look until we had finished decorating the room.
entries.zh: 卡伦答应等我们装饰完房间后再看。

entries.en: Boyes kept the old clock even though it had stopped working years before.
entries.zh: 博伊斯留着那只旧钟，尽管它多年前就不走了。

entries.en: A Ligurian in our walking group lent me a dry pair of gloves.
entries.zh: 我们徒步小组里的一位利古里亚人借给我一双干手套。

entries.en: Ms Statham offered to frame the drawing after seeing how carefully the child had made it.
entries.zh: 斯坦森女士看到孩子画得那么认真，便提出替那幅画装框。

entries.en: Mr Schiff left the gate unlatched so that we could carry the table through.
entries.zh: 希夫先生没扣上门闩，好让我们抬着桌子过去。

entries.en: She kept the notebook she had used during her stay in Mostar.
entries.zh: 她留着自己在莫斯塔停留期间用过的那本笔记本。

entries.en: Illich put a saucer under the dripping tap before going to find a cloth.
entries.zh: 伊里奇先在滴水的水龙头下面放了一个碟子，才去找布。

entries.en: Hutson remembered lending the book but could not remember who had borrowed it.
entries.zh: 赫特森记得把书借出去了，却想不起是谁借走的。

entries.en: Corbusier carried the empty basket downstairs while I gathered the remaining toys.
entries.zh: 我收拾剩下的玩具时，科尔比西耶把空篮子搬下楼。

entries.en: Our host in Cockermouth had left a spare blanket on each bed.
entries.zh: 在科克茅斯接待我们的人在每张床上都放了一条备用毯子。

entries.en: Benedetto left the painting face down until the surprise party began.
entries.zh: 贝内德托把画正面朝下放着，直到惊喜派对开始。

entries.en: Poul had brought the small saucepan because the larger one would not fit in the bag.
entries.zh: 波尔带了小炖锅，因为大的那只装不进袋子。

entries.en: Philby offered to carry the sleeping dog, but it woke as soon as he approached.
entries.zh: 菲尔比提出抱那只睡着的狗，但他一走近，狗就醒了。

entries.en: The room we had rented in Northwood had a little desk beneath the window.
entries.zh: 我们在诺斯伍德租的房间里，窗下放着一张小书桌。

entries.en: Moriarty was trying to untangle the kite string without tearing the paper.
entries.zh: 莫里亚蒂正试着解开放风筝的线，同时避免撕破纸。

entries.en: Leppard had left a basket beside the door for the books we no longer wanted.
entries.zh: 莱帕德在门边放了一个篮子，用来装我们不再要的书。

entries.en: Ms Leman replaced the broken clasp before returning the necklace to its box.
entries.zh: 莱曼女士先换好坏掉的搭扣，再把项链放回盒子。

entries.en: Kemal was saving the largest sheet of paper for the children's map.
entries.zh: 凯末尔把最大的一张纸留着，给孩子们画地图用。

entries.en: Kamara moved the cups indoors before the first drops of rain reached the table.
entries.zh: 第一滴雨落到桌上之前，卡马拉就把杯子搬进了屋。

entries.en: Horley had repaired the umbrella, but its handle was still sticky with glue.
entries.zh: 霍利修好了雨伞，但把手上还有黏糊糊的胶水。

entries.en: Halsall opened the cupboard slowly so that the stacked plates would not fall.
entries.zh: 哈尔索尔慢慢打开柜门，免得叠放的盘子掉下来。

entries.en: Gregorio wrapped the little wooden horse before the children came back into the room.
entries.zh: 孩子们回到房间之前，格雷戈里奥包好了那匹小木马。

entries.en: Dukakis had borrowed a larger car to bring the folding tables home.
entries.zh: 杜卡基斯借了一辆更大的车，准备把折叠桌运回家。

entries.en: Dilke was still looking for a vase when the guests arrived with flowers.
entries.zh: 客人们带着花到来时，迪尔克还在找花瓶。

entries.en: Briscoe held the parcel against her chest to keep it out of the rain.
entries.zh: 布里斯科把包裹抱在胸前，免得它被雨淋湿。

entries.en: Mr Boyer asked us to leave a clear space beside the piano for the singer.
entries.zh: 波伊尔先生请我们在钢琴旁留出一块空地给歌手。

entries.en: The lecturer compared Nixonian policies with the proposals discussed in the previous seminar.
entries.zh: 讲师把尼克松的政策与上次研讨课讨论过的提议作了比较。

entries.en: Romer put a folded blanket between the mirror and the side of the van.
entries.zh: 罗默在镜子和货车侧壁之间垫了一条折好的毯子。

entries.en: Proudfoot kept the torn envelope because the address was still easy to read.
entries.zh: 普劳德富特留着那个破信封，因为上面的地址仍然清晰可读。

entries.en: Paice had brought a book for the journey but spent the whole trip drawing.
entries.zh: 佩斯带了一本书准备路上读，却整个旅程都在画画。

entries.en: Madeley held up the patched coat and asked whether it would last another winter.
entries.zh: 梅德利举起那件打了补丁的外套，问它还能不能再穿一个冬天。

entries.en: Ms Lovelock put the wet photographs on a clean cloth beside the sink.
entries.zh: 洛夫洛克女士把湿照片放在水槽旁的一块干净布上。

entries.en: Krauss had made the shelf wide enough for the books but not for the lamp.
entries.zh: 克劳斯做的架子放书够宽，却放不下那盏灯。

entries.en: Gertie waited until the cat had left the basket before folding the blanket.
entries.zh: 格蒂等猫离开篮子后，才把毯子折起来。

entries.en: Ernesto brought the damaged frame into the light to look for the missing screw.
entries.zh: 欧内斯托把受损的画框拿到亮处，寻找不见了的螺丝。

entries.en: Dugdale took a photograph of the chairs so that we could arrange them the same way later.
entries.zh: 达格代尔给那些椅子拍了一张照片，好让我们之后按原样摆回去。

entries.en: The bag I had bought in Cluny was too small for all the books.
entries.zh: 我在克卢尼买的那个包太小，装不下所有的书。

entries.en: Wojciech had promised to water the plants while we were away.
entries.zh: 沃伊切赫答应在我们外出期间给植物浇水。

entries.en: The translator set aside the letter from Sumitomo to check its handwritten annotations.
entries.zh: 译者把住友商事的信单独放到一旁，准备核对上面的手写批注。

entries.en: Spratt had hidden the present so well that he needed help finding it again.
entries.zh: 斯普拉特把礼物藏得太好，结果还得请人帮忙重新找出来。
